verdict.rationale: Stable documents item-level actions (scan, ship, deposit, shred) giving operators per-item disposal choices, including a 'Shred: Securely destroy physical mail while maintaining digital copies' feature. However, there is no documented storage-window policy (how long mail is retained before default disposal) and no evidence of a shred confirmation receipt/audit trail tied to destruction. Missing for 10: documented storage/retention windows, explicit shred confirmation mechanism, independent corroboration of the shred workflow.
